digest.component_or_area: Jira reconciler differ and mutation filtering
propositions: The raw compute_mutations API must emit field_drift updates for mismatched local vs remote state, serving as a load-bearing positive control for API contract validation.
A4-1 intentionally filters differ-owned field_drift and unbound_local emissions at the production snapshot call-site, which violates the contract by passing remote-only state as both arguments.
The call-site suppression filter must remain in source and tests to enable future migration to real local state without weakening the pure differ contract.
Verification testing confirms the raw differ emits its positive control while the production call-site result contains zero outbound updates for the same input.
Genuine inbound-create and invariant-seed mutations pass through the call-site filter unchanged.
A converged reconciliation pass records mutation_count == 0 with zero per-mutation git rev-parse calls in the production path.
